factcheck.claim: MAMAMOO unveiled the first 4WARD teaser at midnight KST on May 7 for a four-member comeback.
RBW previously confirmed a June full-group album and world tour.
MAMAMOO's last full-group release was the 2022 EP MIC ON with ILLELLA.
The 2026 U.S. tour starts August 12 in New York and spans seven U.S. cities.
The wider world tour opens in Seoul on June 19, MAMAMOO's debut anniversary.
Members have been active individually ahead of the June group return.
